summary: The Lord visited the people in great judgment, spared the righteous from perishing, and delivered them from their enemies.

explicit_facts.text: The Lord had led the people out of the land of Jerusalem and preserved them from falling into the hands of their enemies.
The Lord had told their fathers that those who did not keep his commandments would not prosper in the land.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Omni is the record keeper narrating these verses. The first narration excerpt quotes words the Lord had spoken to their fathers; it is not a new speech in this scene.

The supplied verses do not identify the people further or describe a visible appearance of the Lord. The requested wording about the more wicked Nephites is not in the supplied verses and cannot be added.

Do not invent a visible appearance of the Lord, a specific form of judgment, or a means of deliverance.
